offers_products.reason: Sells hamburgers, chicken sandwiches, fries and breakfast food prepared in its restaurants; franchisees buy the brand and supplies.

offers_services.reason: Operates restaurants and franchising, giving franchisees brand licensing and support; restaurant meal service to diners.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Diners buy burgers and meals via drive-thru, dine-in and delivery apps.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Most restaurants are franchised; franchisees pay royalties and fees and are main direct customers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Repeat restaurant purchases by customers and ongoing franchise royalties from franchisee sales.

cyclical_demand.reason: Low-priced fast food holds up in downturns; diners can trade down, but demand is fairly stable.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sale is a small, frequent fast-food meal.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for food and brand; franchise royalties, not staff time, drive revenue.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are households and individual franchisees, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly franchised, asset-light royalty model, though it owns some company restaurants and leases properties.

notes: Franchise-heavy model; asset-heavy and organization-buyer answers rely on general knowledge of Wendy's franchising.
